answer: Mechanism: kernel-signed invocation leases. Each agent rents a non-transferable 30–90s CPU/TPM slot; the kernel signs at most one live agent per slot and publishes occupancy on a public knoll map. Revenue is escrowed 72h and released only after an ivory-ledger slot-unique memory-hard challenge. Cloning needs fresh lease+compute; marginal EV = task yield − lease − energy − delay − forfeiture < 0.
